title: Perspective on electrochemical CO2 reduction in CO2/O2 mixed gas
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00334B, Perspective

Xiaoling Lai, Jinxian Feng, Yuxuan Xiao, Weng Fai Ip, Hui Pan
State-of-the-art interface design strategies for the selective CO2RR in O2-containing feed gas (CO2/O2) are presented from the following three aspects: (i) O2 passivation, (ii) selective CO2 adsorption, and (iii) direct selective CO2RR.
